The '''Free Zone''' was a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] located on the [[Shadowport/Legends|Shadowport]] of [[Asylum]]. In [[3631 BBY]] it was fought over by two rival syndicates, the [[Blast Crew]] led by [[Tanno Vik]] and the [[Starbolts]] led by [[Oggo]]. After [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] killed Oggo, Vik took over the Free Zone, though his reign was short-lived, as Asylum was attacked by the [[Eternal Fleet]] shortly afterwards, beginning the [[Battle of Asylum]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Free Zone appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion, released with Update 4.0.<ref name="SWTOR" />
